digest.component_or_area: codebase-navigation tooling (Serena symbol lookup) + rebar plan-review overlay & Claude Bash hook
propositions: Explicit AGENTS.md guidance to prefer Serena symbol tools over grep was present but ineffective; an agent enumerated call sites by hand with grep until challenged.
The rule as written is incorrect because Serena/Pyright cannot resolve symbols referenced as string literals (e.g. monkeypatch.setattr), so exclusive Serena use misses real call sites that fail CI.
Serena's index can lag recent edits (reporting stale line numbers) while grep can produce false positives from comment mentions, so the two tools fail in opposite directions.
A non-blocking PreToolUse Bash hook should surface a short reminder on every grep/rg invocation naming find_referencing_symbols and the legitimate string-literal grep exception.

A project-only rebar review criterion and coaching move should fire when source-code references are enumerated by hand or incompletely, directing re-derivation via Serena, scoped only through the .rebar/ overlay.
Serena symbol tools should be made non-deferred in this repo via ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH so using them costs no extra discovery round-trip, removing the friction asymmetry favoring grep.
